entries.title: Michaelis–Menten enzyme kinetics (demonstration)
entries.license: prototype code; no external source data included
assumptions: Idealized parameter values supplied by the user
No measurement noise or biological variability unless separately modeled
verification: Output is non-negative for supported inputs
Rate is monotonic in substrate concentration for fixed positive parameters
Automated software tests cover expected qualitative behavior
limitations: Not fitted to a specific enzyme or experimental dataset
Not a validated prediction for a real biological system

entries.title: SIR compartmental epidemic model (simplified demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
assumptions: Closed population in the simplified formulation
verification: Automated test checks approximate population conservation
limitations: No age, geography, behavior, reporting delay or intervention structure
Not calibrated to a real outbreak

entries.title: One-dimensional heat diffusion (simplified numerical demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
assumptions: Boundary conditions set by the user
verification: Automated test checks stability guard and a stable run
limitations: No comparison to experimental thermal measurements

entries.title: Logistic population growth (analytical demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
verification: Population starts at the supplied initial value
Population remains between initial population and carrying capacity for supported positive parameters
Automated tests cover monotonicity and boundary behaviour
limitations: No stochasticity, age structure, environmental variation or fitted data

entries.title: First-order reaction A to B (analytical demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
assumptions: Fixed volume and no side reactions
verification: Analytical solution checked against expected exponential decay
A+B mass balance is checked in every run
limitations: Not calibrated to a specific chemical reaction; no temperature dependence

entries.title: Single-compartment first-order environmental decay (demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
verification: Non-negative remaining load
Initial load mass balance
Monotonic removal
limitations: Not a site-specific fate/transport or environmental impact model

entries.title: One-compartment concentration decay (teaching demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
verification: Initial concentration equals input amount divided by volume
Concentration remains non-negative and non-increasing
limitations: Not for dose selection, patient care or clinical prediction; no compound or patient data

entries.title: Lotka–Volterra predator–prey system (RK4 demonstration)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
verification: Finite and non-negative populations required
Timestep and step-count limits enforced
limitations: No carrying capacity, stochasticity, spatial effects or field calibration

entries.title: Leaky integrate-and-fire neuron (teaching model)
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
verification: Voltage remains finite
Spike times are bounded by simulation duration
Basic threshold/reset constraints are checked
limitations: No ion-channel conductances, synapses, morphology or biological calibration

entries.title: Temperature-dependent first-order reaction using Arrhenius equation
entries.license: prototype implementation; no external data included
assumptions: User-supplied pre-exponential factor and activation energy
verification: A+B mass balance
Non-negative reactant/product amounts
Rate coefficient calculated from Arrhenius relation
limitations: No thermal feedback, side reactions or measured parameter data
